'''2011 Belgium Regionals Angelo Consoli LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Angelo Consoli]] at [[2011 Belgium Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Angelo
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
